notes.title: Demo Update version 0.3.9.9
notes.content:
Version 0.3.9.9 patch notes: 

New Features:[olist]
Food: Can now recover food supplies in the town by pressing C / Y button.

Stances: 
[olist]
Enemies now play a different idle animation according to the attack they are preparing (Ferocity, Tenacity, Cunning and Agility). 

Allies also play different idle animations after the action is selected.
[/olist]
Skills:
[olist]
Skills are now unlocked by training the specific stat and increasing your training stat. A charge bar will appear to show the progress in that specific stat. The same progress for the next skill can be seen in the status menu in the skills tab.

Added more skills to help balance each damage type's tree.
[/olist][/olist]Improvements:[olist]
Difficulty:
[olist]
Difficulty curve has been flattened a bit.

Training now has a lower chance to injure the Beast.

Skipping the tutorial now yields the same bonuses as going through it (starter will have 1 extra skill and 1 extra trait and you will have an egg waiting for you in the party screen).
[/olist]
UI:
[olist]
Text contrast has been increased (windows are clearer and text color is darker) to make everything more readable.

Button glyphs change.

Resolution can be pushed to 9x in windowed mode.

Transitions to and from the menu have been sped up.

Loading screen now has a progress bar.

Damage font improved.

Questions pop up without the need to press continue.
[/olist]
Other:
[olist]
Stealthy enemies are now a bit more visible.

Fainted allies/enemies become greyish.
[/olist][/olist]
Party Screen: 
[olist]
Can now access party screen from the map (In the Earth Star Trial this is still not the case since it makes sense both thematically and difficulty-wise).

Can now view the gathered Beasts' status from the party change scene to compare with your party.
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo Update version 0.3.9
notes.content:
Version 0.3.9 released thanks for the mountain of feedback! 

 

Changelog v0.3.9: 



General Changes:
[olist]
Camp Food Overhaul:
[olist]
Reduced the chance to get injured if you stay too long in the camp.

Camp now requires food per day to carry out actions. Food gets consumed when a day passes. If there's not enough food to cover the Beasts requirements tooltip displays in red. If training and rest is carried out when low on food, chance to get injured and fail trainings increases as well as Stamina recovery is reduced.

UI will display stocked food both in camp and in overworld.

Food amount available in the overworld increased.

Selected food icon appears in the portrait now.

Tutorials and Guides updated.
[/olist]
Beasts now display when they gain/lose trust in the camp.

Evolution criteria:
[olist]
Bestiary now displays the criteria for Stage Advancement if you've already obtained a non Baby stage of that Species.

Lorelei's Predict can now analyze your Beasts and tell the criteria for Stage Advancement.
[/olist]
Improved the boulder room puzzle in the Earth Trial Area.
[/olist]


Bug Fixes:
[olist]
Several collision, clipping issues in the Earth Trial Area.

General Tooltips now display when Riding Beasts and gaining / losing stamina.

Venomous bite now correctly has a chance to poison target.

Fixed a Stat Gain issue after battle victory.

Fixed an issue with swapping field skills in the overworld.
[/olist]


Please if you are willing to give some feedback to improve the game and haven't already take a few minutes to complete the following survey: 



https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSep2f7NND-FxZ3wdCLlirsrd4FcxMWU8M2iTfs1i09aW_wgMg/viewform?usp=header

notes.title: Demo Update - Hotfix 0.3.8.3
notes.content:

notes.title: Demo Update version 0.3.7
notes.content:
Changelog v0.3.7: 

New features:  
[olist]
 Idle Mode: whenever you're in the camp scene and you are afk or doing other stuff, the Beasts will now rest, play or train on their own, stats, health or trust increased depends on the time spent on idle mode.

The intro and guidance during the start of the game has been greately improved.

notes.title: Demo Update version 0.3.6
notes.content:
Changelog v0.3.6:

New features:

[olist]
 Map: The Map Scene is accessible through the Bestiary or by pressing M in the keyboard or d-pad Up in the gamepad. May need to retrace your steps to unlock a map you already visited.
 Sever Bond: Lets you release Beasts with less than 30% trust. May leave a mysterious orb behind as you sever that connection.
[/olist]


Music:
 New soundtracks in the game! Yoshi_UMR will be composing the music moving forward.

UI:

[olist]
 Added keys to access menus faster, tooltips for the keys are visible when paused in the overworld.
 Key Tooltips (except for field skills which are always enabled for clarity) can now be disabled in the general tab of the options menu. They are baseline enabled.
[/olist]

Fixes:

[olist]
 Fixed a bug with the egg hatch cutscene.
 Fixed a bug related to active field skills when reordering beasts in the pause menu.
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo v0.3.5.2 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Posting the patch notes for the current version with some fixes and other QoL changes:

General:
[olist]
 Pages turning animations are quicker now.
 Bestiary Guides section and tutorials optimized.
[/olist]

Battle:

[olist]
 Assigned action type appears as a tooltip on top of the Beast when the action is selected, can also see what action the enemy picks when the turns are processed.

Fixes:
[olist]
 Fixed a bug with exiting the Camp.
 Fixed a bug with not being able to Pet from the pause menu.
 Several ES Translation fixes.
[/olist]

Thank you for the continuous feedback and support, feel free to also provide feedback to the new discord server!

notes.title: 🎉 Demo Update version 0.3.5
notes.content:
Hello!

Once again thank you for the feedback and for playing the demo. I've been reviewing all comments and making adjustments. 

Here are relevant changes in this version:

🔧 v0.3.5 Changelog:

UI:

 Added the System button in the overworld menu that lets you change Options, Save or Quit.
 Can now check your current party's status from the Party Change screen.

Features:

 Egg Potential: Some eggs may now include extra traits or moves, but beware as they are guarded sometimes!
 Predict option in Town now hints how long it will take for the Beast to advance to a new stage.
 Bestiary now shows a stage/Evo tree for each Beast.
 Bestiary Guides section now correctly displays tutorial information
 A certain character may be looking for a battle somewhere.

Improvements:

 Expanded hints and tutorials during the intro: for example, foods, raising and battle.
 The village's Shop was improved.
 Font shadow has been clared for easier reading.
 Minor graphic improvements.


Fixes:

 Fixed a bug with Critters softlocking the player when effect already in place.
 Fixed a bug that showed party train mode tooltip when it wasn't available.
 Fixed a bug that erased eggs' kin names.
 Fixed a translation bug that named a nonexistent item.


If you’ve got more feedback, feel free to drop it in the forums.

Thanks once more for your support!

notes.title: 🎉 Demo Update! Thank You for the Amazing Feedback!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I just wanted to say a huge thank you to everyone who played the demo, shared their thoughts, and took the time to send feedback. Your comments have been incredibly helpful, I’m reading everything and using it to make the game better.

Based on what you've shared, I’ve uploaded a new version of the demo with several improvements to help streamline the experience, fix bugs, and polish the early-game pacing. Every bit of feedback counts, and I’m actively working on refining the gameplay, onboarding, and overall experience.

Here are relevant changes in this version:

🔧 v0.3.4.2 Changelog:

Keyboard Controls Overhaul:

 Object Interaction and Menu enters now are all built in the same bind with Enter/Space.
 Beast Field Skills now use Q / E / R respectively for a more ergonomical setup.
 Can now use either WASD or Arrows to move in the overworld.

Other changes:

 Intro scene overhauled (no need to start a new game though).
 New Mechanic: Can now select actions in camp for your whole party activating Party Mode. (Mechanic is locked behind first cutscene)
 Some tutorials were improved and added more information for certain mechanics.


Fixes:

 Fixed a bug that disabled interaction with map objects sometimes when time cycles in the overworld.
 Made several ES language fixes.
 Fixed Issue with words going out of dialogue textbox sometimes.
 Fixed a bug with Bolt Field Skill.


If you haven’t already, please consider adding the game to your wishlist or sharing the demo with a friend. It really helps! And if you’ve got more feedback, feel free to drop it in the Steam forums or send it directly.

Thanks again for your support!

notes.title: Astra Bestiary is joining Steam´s Creature Collector Fest with a free demo!
notes.content:
Astra Bestiary is joining Steam´s Creature Collector Fest with a free demo! 

Hi everyone!

I’m happy to announce that the Astra Bestiary demo will be available on May 12 as part of Steam’s Creature Collector Fest!
[previewyoutube=gsnP6nsOCWI;full][/previewyoutube]
Watch the new trailer to get a first look at the world, battles, and Beasts you’ll encounter. The demo includes:

 Over 40 creatures to raise and battle
 4 zones to explore
 The campaign leads up to the first trial


Don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game to stay updated, and share your feedback in the discussions — I’d love to hear what you think!

Thanks for the support, and I can’t wait for you to try it!

- Bicho Feo
